highlights_headline: Upcoming changes update HarfBuzzSharp to HarfBuzz 15.0.0 and expand named script support.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled shaping engine and HarfBuzzSharp packages to 15.0.0, while retaining the existing managed assembly version.
Adds 30 Script constants, including Jurchen, ProtoCuneiform and Seal, bringing named coverage to 179 values. Existing constants, parsing and numeric conversions remain unchanged.
